description: Per-requirement labels for the 52 bundled synthetic cases in inputs/synthetic_cases.json.
note_authorship: Synthetic notes bundled with the repository. Many were written alongside the extractor as regression fixtures.
selection: Not a sample of real notes. 42 of 52 cases were built to end in an abstention; affirmative cases are few.

label_defaults.author: Claude (AI agent)
label_defaults.basis: Written from the note text, the fact meanings in engine/fact_contracts.py, the rule operators in rules/payer_rules.yaml and CPB 0236 Footnote 1 as stored in the policy snapshot, before viewing per-requirement extractor output for these cases. The author had read the extractor source and the existing case-level expected statuses.
